notes:
v4.6.61 — Exact IBKR entry prices, P/L and charts

🎯 EXACT DATA — IBKR bots now show real cost basis + P/L
• Each IBKR bot now records its real per-holding average cost, live price and unrealized P/L (straight from the IBKR account) into its ledger every cycle. The desktop reads these, so the Position Gauge, P/L-by-Position and position list show your TRUE entry price and actual gains/losses — not break-even placeholders.

📈 CHARTS — gauge + equity curves render for IBKR
• Position Gauge no longer shows a false "No open positions" when positions are held (it was hitting a divide-by-zero on a missing entry price and silently failing).
• Equity / lifetime curves now build from the bot's recorded equity snapshots (IBKR has no history feed), and snapshots are recorded from the bot detail page too — so curves fill in and grow over time.

Note: existing positions show exact data on the bots' next cycle; brand-new buys are exact immediately.

Update via the in-app banner.
